acceptance: Trunk coverage no longer starts on every develop push; it runs on a schedule (4-6 a day) or only past a stated commit distance, and still supports dispatch
Map staleness stays within the existing monitor limits for 7 days after the change: no coverage-map staleness issue opened
PR selection map fetch success in ci-paths is unchanged over the same 7 days
Trunk coverage runner-minutes drop at least 60% week over week, with the before/after numbers recorded on this item
context: Source: independent review of the PR-checks versus Trunk split on 2026-10-24 (develop a56738db4; run history 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-24: 465 merges, 466 Trunk push runs, 126 Trunk coverage runs). Waits on the coverage-map id fix because both change the coverage-map path.
description: trunk-coverage.yml runs on every push to develop (trunk-coverage.yml:3-12) with cancel-in-progress, so 71 of 123 push runs (58%) were cancelled, yet it still costs about 23 runner-minutes per merge (about 16 runner-hours a day) and runs the medium tier a third time per merge, instrumented. Its only product is the coverage map that PR selection reads, and selection is fail-closed with a staleness monitor (20 commits / 3 failed runs). Replace the push trigger with 4-6 scheduled runs a day (or a commit-distance guard on push), keeping dispatch and the staleness job.
